'''Proto-Zhensanovian''' is the source-attested ancestral frame for the [[Zhensanovian Languages]].

The extracted language-family source says the major Zhensanovian branches share a common Proto-Zhensanovian ancestor. It does not provide a date, homeland, migration model, or reconstruction table.

== Canon Limits ==

This draft preserves Proto-Zhensanovian as a linguistic relationship marker only. It should not be used to define ancient borders, ethnic origin myths, or political unity before additional canon confirms those claims.
